purpose: Known incomplete playback UI and presentation contracts. New names or occurrences fail the structure check; remove entries when product work closes a gap.

knownGaps.reason: 9c48de9 deliberately replaced the fixed PlayerPanelChrome.contentSize chrome with a width-morphing panel (clusterWidth animates between ControlBar.contentWidth and expandedPlayerControlsContentWidth, PlaybackPanelExpansionTests updated to match). The check still encodes the pre-9c48de9 fixed-width contract from 7676b57; restoring panelChromeSize would revert that shipped product decision, so the gap is recorded until the contract text is redefined.

knownGaps.name: Modules/Playback/Views/SenseZoneVolumeRoot.swift bypasses the platform executor: @Environment(\.dismissWindow) private var dismissWindow
knownGaps.reason: d34c3ae3 lets the SenseZone Environment volume dismiss its own window on the DEBUG request; the call sits inside #if DEBUG (SenseZoneVolumeRoot.swift:58-67) and its @Environment(\.dismissWindow) property backs only that call, the same shape ImmersiveSpaceView's blackout probe is exempted for. Recorded as intentional, not a contract to close.
